and overheating problems are avoided. Glare reduction needs the even distribution of light in the room
without shadows and high contrasts in the working field. The avoidance of cooling loads can be
realisedbyhighefficientredirectionanddistributionofthesunlightinasmallpartofthefacade,while
the rest of the facade is closed by conventional shading devices.

1.2.4. Light transport.Light can be transported from outside by collating it and guiding it through a
light guiding media (light wave guide) into rooms in the depth of the building. It can be transported
over long distances into floor areas or rooms without any window opening. The same system can also
be used for the transport of artificial light at night time for example.
